scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c blue,magenta,yellow "yarn workspace @tickerly/api dev" "yarn workspace @tickerly/web dev" "yarn workspace @tickerly/api worker"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @tickerly/api build && yarn workspace @tickerly/web build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace @tickerly/api start" "yarn workspace @tickerly/web preview --port 5173"
scripts.test: yarn workspace @tickerly/api test && yarn workspace @tickerly/web test
